title: Newmark Arranges Sale and Financing of 100 Bayview, a Premier Office Building in Newport Beach
summary: Newmark announces the Company has arranged the sale and financing of 100 Bayview, a Class A office building totaling 346,335 square feet at 100 Bayview in Newport Beach, California.
body_markdown: Newmark announces the Company has arranged the sale and financing of 100 Bayview, a Class A office building totaling 346,335 square feet at 100 Bayview in Newport Beach, California.
